title: Configuration port encoding
statement: For a machine with $k$ work tapes, encode each natural-number index $j$ as follows: indices $0,1,2$ represent the state, input-head, and input-symbol ports; indices $3$ through $2+k$ represent work-head ports; and indices from $3+k$ up to but not including $3+3k$ represent work-symbol ports, with tape number $ igl loor{(j-3-k)/2} igrfloor$ and Boolean label given by whether $(j-3-k)$ is odd. The next two indices represent the false and true summary ports, followed by the old-bit and new-bit ports; every remaining index also represents the new-bit port.
caveat: The floor notation describes natural-number division.
